CREATE TABLE diary_entry_template ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, mood SMALLINT, description VARCHAR(1000), time_start TIME, time_end TIME, CONSTRAINT uk_diary_entry_template_user_name UNIQUE (user_id, name), CONSTRAINT fk_diary_entry_template_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE );
CREATE INDEX idx_diary_entry_template_user ON diary_entry_template (user_id);
